articles.title: Wilkey announces 2026 campaign for Precinct 3, Place 2 Justice of the Peace
articles.excerpt: He was sworn in on June 23, 2022, the day after retiring from the Temple Police Department, and the court serves Little River Academy, Rogers, Temple and Troy in east Bell County (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Bell County primary ballot features several uncontested races
articles.excerpt: He was the only candidate to file for the seat, and no Democrat entered the race (KDH).
